about:
PandaCodeGen is a custom web development studio for businesses that have outgrown WordPress, Shopify and other template platforms.

We rebuild the digital foundation behind revenue: the website, how search engines and AI systems understand it, and, when required, the tracking used to measure performance. Our work includes controlled migrations to custom Next.js, ecommerce with real pricing and payment logic, and internal tools such as CRMs, dashboards and operations platforms.

Each migration begins with a complete URL and content inventory, mapped redirects, preserved metadata, a controlled cutover and post-launch monitoring. We structure content for search and AI visibility, but we do not promise rankings, traffic or citations that no agency controls.

Every engagement includes a fixed written scope, measurable acceptance criteria and full ownership of the code and production accounts. Tracking and analytics verification is scoped separately because not every project needs it.

PandaCodeGen is operated by Panda Group Ventures L.L.C., based in Texas. We work with businesses across the United States and worldwide.
